workLog.outcome: PR #5140's encoding fix and this branch's merge of origin/main (now carrying the #5142 fix) are both in. The AI Spec Validator on PR #5140 also found a real correctness gap in the new _code_block_lines fence detector: the closing-fence pattern accepted 3+ backticks regardless of the opener's actual length, so a bare 3-backtick line inside a 4-or-more-backtick-opened fence closed the scan early, letting real code after that point escape detection -- the opposite of the documented fail-closed design. Fixed by tracking the opener's length and requiring the closer to match it, with a discriminating regression test (a real code change inside a 4-backtick fence, which the pre-fix implementation would have missed). The validator's second finding (rename handling) was investigated and found to already fail closed: a renamed file's new-path entry always compares head content against an empty base, so non-empty code content in the renamed file is flagged, not silently passed
